models.NearbyMember: A user who appears on the current user's radar — already filtered for privacy and within the requested radius.
models.MatchScore: The composite score (0-100) used to rank nearby members. Combines shared interests, intent overlap, distance bonus, and recency bonus.

relationships: Each NearbyMember has exactly one MatchScore relative to the viewing user.
The radar shows the top 50 NearbyMembers ordered by MatchScore desc.
